INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPORATION_SELECT_SRC
(
                ADDRESS
                ,AM_ID
                ,CD
                ,CIF
                ,CLIENT_CODE
                ,COMP_NM
                ,COMP_SSS_CD
                ,CORP_TYPE
                ,DATE_OF_INCORPORATION
                ,DEL
                ,EMAIL
                ,FAX_NO
                ,ID
                ,IMAGE
                ,IP_ADDR
                ,IS_BUYER
                ,IS_SELLER
                ,MARKET_SEGMENT
                ,MARKET_SEGMENT_ID
                ,NATURE_BUSINESS
                ,NM
                ,PROCESSING_TYPE
                ,REF_NO
                ,RM_BRANCH_ID

                ,RM_ID
                ,RM_TEAM_ID
                ,SEC
                ,SSS_GSIS
                ,STATUS
                ,TEL_NO
                ,TIN
                ,UPDATE_DT
                ,VERSION
                ,WEBSITE
                ,WF_CONTROL
                ,WF_MODEL
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                 CC.ADDRESS
                ,CC.AM_ID
                ,CC.CD
                ,CC.CIF
                ,CC.CLIENT_CODE
                ,CC.COMP_NM
                ,CC.COMP_SSS_CD
                ,CC.CORP_TYPE
                ,CC.DATE_OF_INCORPORATION
                ,CC.DEL
                ,CC.EMAIL
                ,CC.FAX_NO
                ,CC.ID
                ,CC.IMAGE
                ,CC.IP_ADDR
                ,CC.IS_BUYER
                ,CC.IS_SELLER
                ,CC.MARKET_SEGMENT
                ,CC.MARKET_SEGMENT_ID
                ,CC.NATURE_BUSINESS
                ,CC.NM
                ,CC.PROCESSING_TYPE
                ,CC.REF_NO
                ,CC.RM_BRANCH_ID
                ,CC.RM_GRP
                ,CC.RM_ID
                ,CC.RM_TEAM_ID
                ,CC.SEC
                ,CC.SSS_GSIS
                ,CC.STATUS
                ,CC.TEL_NO
                ,CC.TIN
                ,CC.UPDATE_DT
                ,CC.VERSION
                ,CC.WEBSITE
                ,CC.WF_CONTROL
                ,CC.WF_MODEL
                ,CC.FILE_NAME
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.BOB_TBLCORPORATION CC
            JOIN d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPORATION B
            ON CC.ID  = B.ID 
            AND LEFT(CC.FILE_NAME, 5) = LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5)
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';

                ,CORP_TYPE

from 
(
	SELECT 				
                ADDRESS
                ,AM_ID
                ,CD
                ,CIF
                ,CLIENT_CODE
                ,COMP_NM
                ,COMP_SSS_CD
                ,CORP_TYPE
                ,DATE_OF_INCORPORATION
                ,DEL
                ,EMAIL
                ,FAX_NO
                ,ID
                ,IMAGE
                ,IP_ADDR
                ,IS_BUYER
                ,IS_SELLER
                ,MARKET_SEGMENT
                ,MARKET_SEGMENT_ID
                ,NATURE_BUSINESS
                ,NM
                ,PROCESSING_TYPE
                ,REF_NO
                ,RM_BRANCH_ID
                ,RM_GRP
                ,RM_ID
                ,RM_TEAM_ID
                ,SEC
                ,SSS_GSIS
                ,STATUS
                ,TEL_NO
                ,TIN
                ,UPDATE_DT
                ,VERSION
                ,WEBSITE
                ,WF_CONTROL
                ,WF_MODEL
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPORATION_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                ADDRESS
                ,AM_ID
                ,CD
                ,CIF
                ,CLIENT_CODE
                ,COMP_NM
                ,COMP_SSS_CD
                ,CORP_TYPE
                ,DATE_OF_INCORPORATION
                ,DEL
                ,EMAIL
                ,FAX_NO
                ,ID
                ,IMAGE
                ,IP_ADDR
                ,IS_BUYER
                ,IS_SELLER
                ,MARKET_SEGMENT
                ,MARKET_SEGMENT_ID
                ,NATURE_BUSINESS
                ,NM
                ,PROCESSING_TYPE
                ,REF_NO
                ,RM_BRANCH_ID
                ,RM_GRP
                ,RM_ID
                ,RM_TEAM_ID
                ,SEC
                ,SSS_GSIS
                ,STATUS
                ,TEL_NO
                ,TIN
                ,UPDATE_DT
                ,VERSION
                ,WEBSITE
                ,WF_CONTROL
                ,WF_MODEL
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPORATION]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.BOB_TBLCORPORATION A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPORATION_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(LEFT(A.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1') = COALESCE(LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
